scope: Resolve the ten explicit unresolved_owner_decision/source-conflict records carried by completed SGC-03C, SGC-04A, SGC-04B, SGC-04C and SGC-05B coverage. SGC-07B superseded/unsupported/deferred final disposition closure remains separate.

records.decision: Canonical Character motivation is required as Character-domain semantic identity rather than CSW creative truth. Route the field/relationship through the existing Character aggregate/identity-profile owner; CSW remains proposal-only input.
records.invariant: Player-authored motivation may become authoritative only through the Character-domain save/validation path; CSW fragments never silently become Character facts.

records.decision: Retain the two published Taser source contexts as explicit distinct/conflicting source variants. Do not merge identities without later authoritative source evidence.
records.owner: Governed Item content registry / D17-facing Item Definitions
records.invariant: No numerical balance or identity fact is inferred to force one canonical Taser definition.

records.decision: Keep all seven unspecified energy-weapon capacities explicitly unknown. Unknown is not zero, unlimited, empty, full or not-applicable; later authoritative source evidence may replace unknown through the owning content path.
records.owner: Governed Item content registry / D17-facing Item Definitions
records.invariant: No capacity is authored merely to complete reload/charge UI.

records.decision: Energy Sniper Rifle, Plasma Carbine and Cryo Blaster remain source-reference-only names and are not promoted to governed Item Definitions without authoritative definition evidence.
records.owner: SGC-07B deferred disposition closure; future governed Item source-recovery only if authoritative evidence exists
records.invariant: No damage, range, weight, cost or other definition fields are inferred from names.

records.decision: Route CEW-classified human-level/sapient Havalaean animals through the existing Creature/NPC Scene and Encounter implementation path. CEW supplies personhood/ecology classification; PPIA-02 supplies the Creature/NPC experience contract; MV-IA-F005 owns Scene/Session placement and MV-IA-F012 owns Encounter participant composition/execution.
records.owner: MV-IA-F005 + MV-IA-F012 consuming PPIA-02 and CEW-10
records.invariant: NPC projection preserves animal ecological identity, sapient autonomy and consent; it never implies humanoid identity, ownership, tamability or obedience.

records.decision: Keep all 27 canonical creature harvest profiles explicitly non-executable while authored harvest mode/yield evidence is absent. Any later executable profile must enter through governed ICF/source-content recovery with authoritative evidence.
records.owner: SGC-07B deferred disposition closure; ICF source/content owner for any later evidence-backed authoring
records.invariant: No anatomy, yield, edibility, safety, legality or effect facts are invented.

records.decision: Retain all 93 PPIA-02 creature candidates as deferred source-review records. No candidate is promoted, excluded or assigned invented gameplay facts in SGC-07A; SGC-07B performs the explicit deferred/provenance/unsupported disposition closure.
records.invariant: Name-only binding and automatic canonical promotion remain prohibited.

records.decision: Retain all 10 recovered R1 vehicle/system structural candidates as deferred source-review records. No Definition promotion or invented mechanics occur in SGC-07A; SGC-07B performs the explicit deferred/provenance/unsupported disposition closure.
records.invariant: Recovered headings do not authorize runtime behavior or canonical Definition creation.

records.decision: Keep source-unspecified vehicle Resource quantity, capacity, compatibility, system-presence and operating-envelope fields explicitly unknown until authoritative source/content evidence resolves them.
records.owner: PPIA-04 content/provenance with MIB-14 runtime validation
records.invariant: Unknown is not converted to zero, unlimited, absent, compatible or available.

records.decision: The generic rest/exhaustion model belongs in the existing Character/Condition execution seam rather than DPL. MV-IA-F004 owns Character Resources/Conditions and authoritative Character state; Stage-A A7 owns Action/Effect execution; DPL-05 remains source/profile-scoped medicine and recovery definition evidence.
records.owner: MV-IA-F004 + Stage-A A7 consuming DPL-05 recovery definitions
records.invariant: SGC-07A assigns the owner seam only; it invents no rest cadence, exhaustion track, recovery amount or universal health ledger.
